roadmap.title: Casual story and full collectible route
roadmap.description: Play on Casual, keep one manual save per major region, collect all files, Mr. Raccoons, safes, BSAA containers, and Plant 43 seedlings, and complete every location-specific combat setup before each area locks.

roadmap.title: Casual speedrun and restriction stack
roadmap.description: Buy Koketsu, start a fresh Casual game, never collect Blood Collector or consume healing, stay under four hours, and release Elpis.

roadmap.title: Insanity and difficulty stack
roadmap.description: Spend the speedrun rewards on Infinite Ammo and Infinite RPG, complete Insanity, make an Ink Ribbon typewriter save, and use the faster destroy-Elpis ending.

roadmap.title: Bonus gallery cleanup
roadmap.description: After the difficulty runs provide enough CP, buy and individually view every Model and Concept Art entry.

achievements.description: Encounter an outbreak in Wrenwood.
achievements.summary: Finish Leon’s opening outbreak sequence in Wrenwood.

guide.context: This story milestone is automatic and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Advance through Leon’s first @loc{Wrenwood} section until control passes away from him and the outbreak encounter concludes.

achievements.description: Reach the basement of the care center.
achievements.summary: Escape the Isolation Ward as Grace and enter the Care Center basement.

guide.context: The basement transition is part of the required story route and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Complete Grace’s @loc{Care Center Isolation Ward} objectives and follow the exit into the basement.

achievements.description: Reach the courtyard of the care center.
achievements.summary: Open the Care Center’s three-Quartz door as Grace and reach the courtyard.

guide.context: Moon, Sun, and Star Quartz are mandatory key items gathered during the Care Center route.

steps.text: Place all three Quartz pieces in the locked door in @loc{Central Hall}, open it, and descend into the @loc{Care Center Courtyard}.

achievements.description: Escape the care center.
achievements.summary: Complete Rhodes Hill and escape the Water Treatment Plant as Grace.

guide.context: The escape follows the Care Center Courtyard and Water Treatment objectives and is unavoidable in the main story.

steps.text: Finish Grace’s @loc{Water Treatment Plant} sequence and leave @loc{Rhodes Hill}.

achievements.description: Reach the ground using the suspended platform.
achievements.summary: Ride the Willis Tower suspended platform to ground level as Leon.

guide.context: This traversal occurs on the mandatory East Raccoon City route.

steps.text: Progress through @loc{Willis Tower}, board the suspended platform, and ride it to the ground.

achievements.description: Arrive at R.P.D.
achievements.summary: Enter the Raccoon City Police Department as Leon.

guide.context: The R.P.D. entrance is a required Raccoon City Center story objective.

steps.text: Follow Leon’s route through @loc{Raccoon City Center} and cross into the @loc{R.P.D.}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Super Tyrant.
achievements.summary: Escape the R.P.D. and defeat the Super Tyrant as Leon.

guide.context: The Super Tyrant ends the R.P.D. section and cannot be skipped.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{R.P.D.} escape, then defeat the @enemy{Super Tyrant} in the mandatory boss encounter.

achievements.description: Find ARK.
achievements.summary: Reach the ARK Loading Dock as Leon.

guide.context: Arrival at ARK is a mandatory late-story transition.

steps.text: Continue Leon’s main route until he enters @loc{ARK Loading Dock}.

achievements.description: Start exploring the lower levels of ARK.
achievements.summary: Reach ARK’s Dump as Grace and begin exploring the lower levels.

guide.context: Control switches to Grace automatically before the lower-level search begins.

steps.text: Progress through @loc{ARK} until Grace arrives at the @loc{Dump}.

achievements.description: Complete the main story by releasing Elpis.
achievements.summary: Finish the story by selecting “Release Elpis” at the final decision.

guide.context: The alternative “Destroy Elpis” route does not satisfy this ending requirement.

steps.text: Reach the final choice and select the literal option @mechanic{Release Elpis}.
Complete the remaining ending sequence.

achievements.description: Complete the main story on at least Casual difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete the main story on Casual difficulty or higher.

guide.context: Difficulty achievements stack, so any Standard or Insanity completion also awards this requirement.

steps.text: Start a New Game on @mechanic{Casual} or a higher difficulty and finish either ending.

achievements.description: Complete the main story on at least Standard (Modern) difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete the main story on Standard (Modern) difficulty or higher.

guide.context: Standard (Classic) and Insanity completions also satisfy the Modern requirement.

steps.text: Start a New Game on @mechanic{Standard (Modern)} or a higher difficulty and finish either ending.

achievements.description: Complete the main story on at least Standard (Classic) difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete the main story on Standard (Classic) difficulty or Insanity.

guide.context: Classic mode requires Ink Ribbons for manual typewriter saves; Insanity also awards every lower difficulty achievement.

steps.text: Start a New Game on @mechanic{Standard (Classic)} or @mechanic{Insanity} and finish either ending.

achievements.description: Complete the main story on Insanity difficulty.
achievements.summary: Unlock Insanity by finishing the story once, then complete a New Game on Insanity.

guide.context: Bonus equipment remains achievement-safe. Infinite RPG is Leon-only, while Infinite Ammo supplies Grace’s Requiem; choosing “Destroy Elpis” skips the final boss on this run.

steps.text: Complete any difficulty once to unlock @mechanic{Insanity}.
Accumulate 100,000 CP from the collectible and speedrun clears, then buy @item{Infinite Ammo} and @item{Infinite RPG} under @mechanic{Bonuses > Special Content}.
Start a fresh @mechanic{Insanity} game, use the bonus equipment, and finish either ending.

achievements.displayName: Out of Sight, Out of Mind
achievements.description: Store an item in the item box as Grace.
achievements.summary: As Grace, move any carried item into the Care Center Guard Office item box.

guide.context: The Guard Office is the first convenient Grace safe room with storage.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Care Center Guard Office} safe room.
Open the @item{item box}, select any inventory item, and move that item into storage.

achievements.description: Use an ink ribbon to save at a typewriter.
achievements.summary: On Standard (Classic) or Insanity, spend one Ink Ribbon on a manual typewriter save.

guide.context: Ink Ribbons do not appear on Casual or Standard (Modern).

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Standard (Classic)} or @mechanic{Insanity} and pick up an @item{Ink Ribbon}.
Use any @item{typewriter} and confirm a manual save, consuming one Ink Ribbon.

achievements.description: Unlock a drawer with a lockpick.
achievements.summary: As Grace, take the Lead Researcher’s Office Lockpick and use it on a locked Care Center drawer.

guide.context: Locked drawers appear on the map when Grace approaches them; an East Wing Lobby drawer is available soon after the Lockpick.

steps.text: Visit @loc{East Wing 2F — Lead Researcher’s Office}, the typewriter room, and collect the @item{Lockpick} placed immediately to the machine’s left.
Return to the @loc{East Wing Lobby} hallway and unlock its marked drawer with the Lockpick.

achievements.description: Defeat a zombie using the hemolytic injector.
achievements.summary: As Grace, stealth-kill a Care Center zombie with the Examination Room Hemolytic Injector.

guide.context: The nearby zombie begins with its back turned, making this the earliest controlled setup.

steps.text: Inside the @loc{East Wing Examination Room}, pick up the white-desk @item{Hemolytic Injector}.
Remain crouched, approach the nearby zombie from behind, and use the displayed stealth-injection prompt.

achievements.description: Unlock a crafting recipe using analysis.
achievements.summary: Analyze Blood Specimen (Denatured) in the Care Center Blood Lab and turn every atom red.

guide.context: The completed analysis unlocks the Handgun Ammo and Hemolytic Injector recipes.

steps.text: In the @loc{Blood Lab}, take @item{Blood Collector} and its purple @item{Blood Specimen (Denatured)}.
Insert the specimen into the @mechanic{Analyzer} and manipulate the sequence until every atom is red.

achievements.description: Craft an item using the blood collector.
achievements.summary: Use Grace’s Blood Collector to gather infected blood, then craft an infected-blood item.

guide.context: The Denatured-specimen analysis must first unlock recipes such as Handgun Ammo and Hemolytic Injector.

steps.text: Complete the @item{Blood Specimen (Denatured)} analysis in the @loc{Blood Lab}.
Fill @item{Blood Collector} from a floor blood bucket or a defeated zombie.
Open @mechanic{Crafting} and make @item{Handgun Ammo}, @item{Hemolytic Injector}, or another recipe that spends infected blood.

achievements.description: Use 300 microsamples of infected blood.
achievements.summary: Spend 300 infected-blood microsamples on Grace’s crafting recipes.

guide.context: The cumulative counter survives manual-save reloads and later playthroughs.

steps.text: Unlock infected-blood crafting through the @loc{Blood Lab} Analyzer.
Fill @item{Blood Collector}, make a manual save, and craft blood-costing items until the stored blood is depleted.
Reload the save and craft again until total expenditure reaches 300 microsamples.

achievements.description: Stun the Girl with Requiem.
achievements.summary: Stun the Girl by shooting her once with Grace’s Requiem revolver.

guide.context: The Water Treatment Plant’s three-switch sequence supplies Requiem ammunition specifically for stopping the pursuer.

steps.text: Reach the three-power-switch objective in the @loc{Water Treatment Plant}.
When @enemy{the Girl} approaches, fire one @item{Requiem} round into her and confirm that she collapses into the stunned state.

achievements.description: Destroy one Mr. Raccoon memoriam.
achievements.summary: Destroy one Mr. Raccoon memoriam with a firearm or melee strike.

guide.context: Mr. Raccoons move and emit a sound, which helps identify them.

steps.text: During Leon’s @loc{Care Center} segment, pass through the chainsaw-cut door and strike or shoot the @item{Mr. Raccoon memoriam} on the fireplace.

achievements.description: Parry an enemy attack.
achievements.summary: As Leon, parry a melee attack with the combat hatchet immediately before impact.

guide.context: A dull hatchet cannot protect Leon reliably; use its displayed maintenance input to resharpen it when needed.

steps.text: Face any melee enemy while Leon’s @item{combat hatchet} is ready.
Press the parry input just before the enemy’s attack connects.

achievements.description: Throw a weapon dropped by an enemy.
achievements.summary: As Leon, throw an enemy’s dropped melee weapon at another enemy.

guide.context: The opening Wrenwood street includes an armed zombie, so this can be earned before leaving the prologue.

steps.text: Kill a zombie carrying a melee weapon in @loc{Wrenwood}.
Stand over the dropped weapon and use its prompt; Leon automatically throws it at the nearest valid enemy.

achievements.description: Defeat three zombies with a hatchet finishing attack.
achievements.summary: As Leon, kill three zombies with combat-hatchet finishing attacks.

guide.context: Head or leg shots commonly knock zombies down and expose the finisher prompt; the total is cumulative.

steps.text: Weaken a zombie until the displayed @item{hatchet finisher} prompt appears.
Use the finisher to kill the downed zombie.
Perform the same finishing kill on two more zombies.

achievements.description: Purchase an item from the supply box.
achievements.summary: Buy any item from the Supply Box at East Raccoon City’s Central Camp.

guide.context: The Tactical Tracker causes defeated enemies to award the credits spent at Supply Boxes.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Central Camp} and activate the green @mechanic{Supply Box} beside the save point.
Select any affordable item and confirm the purchase.

achievements.description: Upgrade a weapon.
achievements.summary: Break the first Care Center Attic Warped Closet and attach its Compensator to Leon’s pistol.

guide.context: The closet lies between Attic and Attic Storage during Leon’s return, before he descends into the Care Center.

steps.text: Use Leon’s @item{combat hatchet} to break the first @item{Warped Closet} on the route from @loc{Attic} to @loc{Attic Storage}.
Take the @item{Compensator}, open the inventory, and combine it with Leon’s pistol.

achievements.description: Stop one of Victor’s attacks on the highway.
achievements.summary: During the East Raccoon City motorcycle chase, shoot Victor before he fires an RPG.

guide.context: Victor presents two interruption windows and a preceding autosave can be reloaded after a miss.

steps.text: After detonating the East Raccoon City gate, continue into Leon’s motorcycle sequence.
When @npc{Victor} rides ahead and a red warning arrow appears, fire the unlimited SMG at him before the RPG launches.

achievements.description: Craft every possible item with Leon.
achievements.summary: As Leon, craft all nine recipe entries, including both distinct methods for Mixed Herb (G+G+G).

guide.context: Recipe credit persists through manual-save reloads. Raccoon City Center exposes the full recipe list; buy the SMG if Machine Gun Ammo remains hidden, and inspect Crafting for any “?????” entry.

collectibles.name: Mixed Herb (G+G)
collectibles.method: Combine two @item{Green Herbs}.

collectibles.name: Mixed Herb (G+G+G), direct
collectibles.method: Combine three @item{Green Herbs} in one recipe.

collectibles.name: Mixed Herb (G+G+G), upgraded
collectibles.method: Add one @item{Green Herb} to an existing @item{Mixed Herb (G+G)}.

collectibles.name: Handgun Ammo
collectibles.method: Combine @item{Scrap} with @item{Gunpowder Small}.

collectibles.name: Shotgun Ammo
collectibles.method: Combine @item{Scrap} with @item{Gunpowder Larger}.

collectibles.name: Rifle Ammo
collectibles.method: Combine @item{Scrap} with @item{Gunpowder Large}.

collectibles.name: Machine Gun Ammo
collectibles.method: After obtaining an SMG, combine @item{Scrap} with @item{Gunpowder Small} through the Machine Gun Ammo recipe.

collectibles.name: Hand Grenade
collectibles.method: Combine @item{Scrap} with @item{Gunpowder Large} through the Hand Grenade recipe.

collectibles.name: Stacked Hand Grenade
collectibles.method: Combine two @item{Hand Grenades}.

achievements.description: Defeat at least three enemies with a single Requiem shot.
achievements.summary: As Grace, kill at least three aligned zombies with one penetrating Requiem shot.

guide.context: The East Wing corridor after Examination Room naturally sends three zombies toward Grace in a line.

steps.text: Reach the corridor between @loc{Examination Room} and @loc{Waiting Room} in the Care Center East Wing.
Wait until the three approaching zombies overlap, then fire one @item{Requiem} round through all three.

achievements.description: Cut the tongue off a Licker β2 using the hatchet.
achievements.summary: As Leon during his second ARK section, hatchet-counter a Licker β2 tongue attack.

guide.context: Licker β2 enemies use the tongue infrequently, so maintain distance and keep the crawler alive until the correct attack begins.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Licker β2} during Leon’s second @loc{ARK} section.
Move back and forth at range until the Licker launches its tongue.
Press the hatchet-counter input just before the tongue reaches Leon to sever it.

achievements.description: Defeat the chef in the care center in the main story.
achievements.summary: Kill the cleaver-wielding Chef in the Care Center Kitchen as Grace or Leon.

guide.context: Grace can return after gaining more ammunition, and Leon receives another opportunity during his later Care Center visit.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Care Center Kitchen} and identify the large @enemy{Chef} carrying a cleaver.
Kill the Chef; on Casual, one Requiem headshot followed by roughly four or five pistol headshots is sufficient.

achievements.description: Defeat the two singers in the main story.
achievements.summary: As Grace, kill the two singing women in the Care Center’s Bar & Lounge and Conference Room.

guide.context: Both singers are optional enemies and can be heard before they are seen. The Conference Room becomes available after Grace obtains Level 1 Wristband.

collectibles.name: West Wing singer
collectibles.method: Kill the singing woman in the white dress.

collectibles.name: East Wing singer
collectibles.method: After obtaining @item{Level 1 Wristband}, enter the Conference Room and kill the singing woman in the turquoise dress.

achievements.description: Defeat a Chunk as Grace.
achievements.summary: As Grace, kill the Chunk beside the Care Center East Wing’s Level 1 Wristband.

guide.context: This is Grace’s only killable Chunk. Its final appearance occurs after Level 3 Wristband opens Emily’s cell.

steps.text: Pick up @item{Level 1 Wristband} beside the @loc{Lead Researcher’s Office} on East Wing 2F.
Fight the pursuing @enemy{Chunk} until it dies; on Casual, about one Requiem headshot and sixteen pistol headshots are sufficient.
If ammunition is short, return before carrying Emily away after using @item{Level 3 Wristband}.

achievements.description: Make a zombie attack another zombie in the hospital wards.
achievements.summary: In the Care Center Waiting Room, use the Dining Room Empty Bottle to make the blind zombie attack the maid zombie.

guide.context: Incidental friendly fire does not qualify; the blind zombie must react to the bottle noise. A manual save protects the only controlled setup.

steps.text: Take the @item{Empty Bottle} from the shelf behind the @loc{West Wing Dining Room} table and keep it.
After leaving @loc{Examination Room}, save manually, kill the three zombies in the red corridor, and enter @loc{Waiting Room}.
Break the first vase and hide so the blind man in white and maid in black investigate the same point without hearing Grace’s footsteps.
Once both zombies are adjacent, target the maid with @item{Empty Bottle} so the sound provokes the blind zombie into striking her. Reload if either target dies or the maid leaves.

achievements.description: Defeat 300 enemies.
achievements.summary: Defeat 300 enemies across any combination of playthroughs, reloads, and checkpoint restarts.

guide.context: The total is cumulative and the campaign contains more than enough enemies during completion cleanup.

steps.text: Continue killing enemies through the story and later runs until the cumulative total reaches 300.

achievements.description: Defeat all the Plant 43 seedlings.
achievements.summary: As Leon after Super Tyrant, kill the train Plant 43 seedling and all eight seedlings in the following cave.

guide.context: Plant 43 seedlings take damage when their mouths open. The first encounter is mandatory; the cave must be fully cleared before leaving.

collectibles.name: Train seedling
collectibles.method: Shoot the mandatory seedling when its mouth opens.

collectibles.name: Cave entrance seedling
collectibles.method: Kill the seedling beside the opening stretch of the main path.

collectibles.name: Main-path pair, first
collectibles.method: Kill the first of the two seedlings on the main route.

collectibles.name: Main-path pair, second
collectibles.method: Kill the second seedling beside the previous one.

collectibles.name: Left side-path seedling
collectibles.method: Take the left branch and kill the seedling that grabs Leon’s feet.

collectibles.name: Flooded-section seedling
collectibles.method: Return to the main route and kill the seedling in the water.

collectibles.name: Flooded-left seedling
collectibles.method: Turn left from the previous kill and destroy the next seedling.

collectibles.name: Exit-path pair, first
collectibles.method: Kill the first of the final pair.

collectibles.name: Exit-path pair, second
collectibles.method: Kill the second of the final pair before leaving the cave.

achievements.description: Open every safe in the main story.
achievements.summary: As Grace, open all five main-story safes with the correct combination for the current difficulty.

guide.context: Safe combinations change on Insanity. The five safes are split between the Care Center, its basement, and ARK.

collectibles.name: Bar & Lounge safe
collectibles.method: Use L10-R80-L30 on Casual/Standard, or R20-L50-R30 on Insanity.

collectibles.name: Examination Room safe
collectibles.method: Use R30-L10-R50 on Casual/Standard, or L50-R30-L90 on Insanity.

collectibles.name: Furnace safe
collectibles.method: Use R60-L40-R80 on Casual/Standard, or L70-R50-L20 on Insanity.

collectibles.name: Sterilization Chamber safe
collectibles.method: Use R10-L90-R20 on Casual/Standard, or L80-R50-L0 on Insanity.

collectibles.name: Monitor Control Room safe
collectibles.method: Use L50-R60-L80 on Casual/Standard, or R20-L0-R70 on Insanity.

achievements.description: Open all BSAA containers.
achievements.summary: As Leon, use the BSAA Container Keys to open all three blue containers in East Raccoon City.

guide.context: A story cutscene grants the keys before the route branches. Nearby containers are marked on the map.

collectibles.name: East-road container
collectibles.location: @loc{Main road between Gas Station and Cedarbrook Apartments}
collectibles.method: At the road’s east end, climb behind the truck and open the blue container.

collectibles.name: Central Camp container
collectibles.method: Open the blue container in the corner beside the tent.

collectibles.name: Applegate Hotel container
collectibles.method: Traverse @loc{Ridgewood Station} back to the starting side of Raccoon City and open the container outside the hotel.

achievements.description: Read all the files in the main story.
achievements.summary: Read all 75 main-story files across Wrenwood, Rhodes Hill, Raccoon City, the R.P.D., the Orphanage, and ARK.

guide.context: Files persist across playthroughs and are tracked in the Files menu, although menu order differs from discovery order. There is no chapter select, so keep a manual save from every major area.

collectibles.name: Investigation Report
collectibles.method: Open Items, rotate the Investigation Report, expose the photo protruding from the folder, and read it.

collectibles.name: Wrenwood City Guide
collectibles.method: Read the city map on the right side of the street.

collectibles.name: Hotel Pamphlet
collectibles.method: Beyond the Old Key door, pick up the paper from the floor near the stairs.

collectibles.name: Notice of Closure
collectibles.method: Go behind reception into the back room and open the blue drawer.

collectibles.name: Alyssa’s Journal
collectibles.method: Inspect the downstairs painting; the file is awarded through the story.

collectibles.name: Report on Victor Gideon
collectibles.method: Continue until the mandatory cutscene places the file in the menu.

collectibles.name: Progress Notes
collectibles.method: Read the document on the small table when Grace regains control.

collectibles.name: Note on Cardboard Box
collectibles.method: Open the closet and read the note.

collectibles.name: Care Center Pamphlet
collectibles.method: Read the pamphlet on the coffee table.

collectibles.name: Whiteboard Scrawl
collectibles.method: Read the whiteboard beside the exit.

collectibles.name: Folded Note
collectibles.method: After Bar & Lounge, turn left in the corridor and inspect the white coat.

collectibles.name: Manager email copy
collectibles.method: Read the page on the cupboard.

collectibles.name: Note to a Chairman
collectibles.method: Inspect the trash bin in the room with the zombie.

collectibles.name: Chairman’s Note
collectibles.method: Use the Pencil to shade the note and read the revealed writing.

collectibles.name: Blood Compound Synthesis
collectibles.method: Read the document on the table opposite the specimen station.

collectibles.name: Safe Replacements
collectibles.method: Read the file beside the open safe behind the counter.

collectibles.name: Lead Researcher’s Picture 2
collectibles.method: Inspect the picture on the cupboard.

collectibles.name: Lead Researcher’s Picture 1
collectibles.method: Inspect the picture on the desk.

collectibles.name: Lead Researcher’s Picture 3
collectibles.method: Inspect the framed picture on the desk.

collectibles.name: Lead Researcher’s Message
collectibles.method: Read the message on the other cupboard.

collectibles.name: Victor’s Journal Entry
collectibles.method: Use Level 1 Wristband on the Blood Lab door and read the journal on the table.

collectibles.name: Construction Notice
collectibles.method: Open the Level 1 gate south of Kitchen and read the right-hand whiteboard.

collectibles.name: Bar & Lounge Safe Code
collectibles.method: After Garage, go upstairs and read the document on the first desk.

collectibles.name: Background Check
collectibles.method: Read the document on the rear-right desk.

collectibles.name: Disposal Team Report
collectibles.method: At the far end of the middle shelving row, examine the cardboard carton.

collectibles.name: Examination Room Safe Code
collectibles.method: Return to the room where Chunk emerged and read the locker note.

collectibles.name: Patient Medical Records
collectibles.method: Read the file on the desk beside the singer encounter.

collectibles.name: Unlocking the Organ Transport Box
collectibles.method: Use Corrosive on the padlock, solve Star-Sun-Moon-Sun on Casual, and open the Leatherbound Notebook.

collectibles.name: Spencer’s Research I
collectibles.method: Read the second file inside the opened Leatherbound Notebook.

collectibles.name: Double Mutation
collectibles.method: Use Level 2 Wristband on the northeast East Wing door and inspect the cardboard box.

collectibles.name: Nurse’s Log
collectibles.method: Read the log on the desk beside Double Mutation.

collectibles.name: Satiety Suppression Medical Records
collectibles.method: When Leon resumes, pass through the first door and search the rear of the room opposite the pushed cupboard.

collectibles.name: Basement Safe Code
collectibles.method: Immediately before the stairs down, use Leon’s hatchet on the right-hand closet.

collectibles.name: Dishwasher’s Note
collectibles.method: Break the closet on the left-hand route from Chairman’s Office.

collectibles.name: Special Directive for Raccoon City
collectibles.method: Receive the file automatically when control returns to Grace.

collectibles.name: Report on Raccoon City Syndrome
collectibles.method: Receive the second automatic file when control returns to Grace.

collectibles.name: Staff Member’s Last Words
collectibles.method: Walk a few steps from Grace’s start and inspect the corpse.

collectibles.name: Operation to Eliminate “The Girl”
collectibles.method: Read the file in the CCTV safe room.

collectibles.name: Unlocking the Cells
collectibles.method: After the corridor cutscene, read the notice above the story lever.

collectibles.name: Technician’s Note
collectibles.method: Read the note on the workbench beside Mr. Raccoon 7.

collectibles.name: Security Guard’s Report
collectibles.method: Read the report in the room containing Safe 3.

collectibles.name: Visitor Record
collectibles.method: After the courtyard cutscene, enter the house and inspect the wooden cupboard.

collectibles.name: Note Regarding Research Results
collectibles.method: Read the document on the main desk in the next room.

collectibles.name: Spencer’s Research II
collectibles.method: After activating the elevator with Double Helix Model, read the file on the reception desk.

collectibles.name: Subject 170 Record
collectibles.method: Find the document on a stretcher near the room’s exit.

collectibles.name: Grace Ashcroft Blood Analysis Report
collectibles.method: Go upstairs from Collection & Testing and read the report on the desk.

collectibles.name: Roof Hatch Manual
collectibles.method: When Grace resumes, reach the typewriter safe room and read the file beside it.

collectibles.name: Report on the Raccoon City Incident
collectibles.method: Receive the file automatically when Leon enters Raccoon City.

collectibles.name: Raccoon City Incident Newspaper
collectibles.method: Walk forward and collect the paper on the right beside the trash bags.

collectibles.name: Orders for the Engineer Corps
collectibles.method: Read the document inside the blue BSAA tent.

collectibles.name: Battery Storage Locations
collectibles.method: In the flooded section with one zombie, inspect the red-lit box right of the gate.

collectibles.name: Inventory List
collectibles.method: After the BSAA Container Keys cutscene, read the list in the open container immediately left.

collectibles.name: Engineer Corps Note
collectibles.method: Read the note beside the yellow crate.

collectibles.name: R.P.D. Perimeter Report
collectibles.method: Read the report on the box opposite the save point.

collectibles.name: Top Secret Operation
collectibles.method: Read the file on the first desk to the right.

collectibles.name: Record of Events
collectibles.method: Read the chalkboard.

collectibles.name: Scavenger Hunt — Clue 2
collectibles.method: Shoot down the Reception ladder, follow the corridor past Library, and inspect the right shelf; rotate the file to read it.

collectibles.name: Library Card
collectibles.method: Open the desk drawer and wait for the card to appear.

collectibles.name: Scavenger Hunt — Clue 1
collectibles.method: Inspect the brown jacket opposite the entrance and rotate the clue.

collectibles.name: Barry’s To Do List
collectibles.method: Read the list on the leftmost desk.

collectibles.name: Photograph
collectibles.method: After reading Files 57–60, inspect the brown leather book beside the locked wooden door and open it.

collectibles.name: Toe Tag
collectibles.method: After pulling the wall lever, enter the side room, open the right coffin, and read the back of the tag.

collectibles.name: Series 60 Results
collectibles.method: In the white corridor, enter the first green-lit door on the right and read the file ahead.

collectibles.name: New Researcher’s Notebook
collectibles.method: Read the notebook on the back-right desk in the same room.

collectibles.name: Guide Pamphlet
collectibles.method: When Leon resumes after the Orphanage, survive the chase; after the cutscene, turn around and inspect the bench.

collectibles.name: N0-AH Status Report
collectibles.method: After the decontamination tunnel, enter the green door on the left and read the wall monitor.

collectibles.name: Raccoon City Bioweapon Research — Report
collectibles.method: Past the gold-skeleton stairs, take the nearest right-side green door and read the first wall monitor.

collectibles.name: Product Catalog 1 (2026)
collectibles.method: Read the second wall monitor.

collectibles.name: Product Catalog 2 (2026)
collectibles.method: Read the third wall monitor.

collectibles.name: Access Log: 51st Assembly Minutes
collectibles.method: Use Magnetic Key on the red door by the upstairs typewriter, enter the first green door from the red-floor Lobby, and inspect the right monitor.

collectibles.name: Sterilization Chamber Safe
collectibles.method: Continue through the next green door, descend, and read the file on the crate at the first corner.

collectibles.name: Monitor Control Room Safe
collectibles.method: Search the rightmost open container in the middle row.

collectibles.name: Access Log: First Assembly Minutes
collectibles.method: Use both orbs in the red-floor Lobby, then read the last monitor on the right wall before touching the large end console.

collectibles.name: Alyssa’s Interview Notes
collectibles.method: After File 73, activate the main console and receive this file automatically in the cutscene.

collectibles.name: Letter from Patrick
collectibles.method: Receive the second automatic file during the same cutscene.

achievements.description: Destroy every Mr. Raccoon memoriam.
achievements.summary: Destroy all 25 Mr. Raccoon memorabilia across the Care Center, Raccoon City, the R.P.D., and ARK.

guide.context: Destroyed memorabilia persist across playthroughs. Bonus maps can mark most remaining locations after one completion, but the Care Center rooftop garden Mr. Raccoon memoriam and the R.P.D. Library bookshelf Mr. Raccoon memoriam are easy to overlook.

collectibles.name: Care Center fireplace
collectibles.method: After cutting the chainsaw door, pass through the next door and destroy the memoriam on the fireplace.

collectibles.name: East Wing Lobby desk
collectibles.method: Use East Wing Keycard and destroy the memoriam on the reception desk.

collectibles.name: Waiting Room corridor
collectibles.method: At the east end of the corridor beyond Waiting Room, destroy the memoriam before going upstairs.

collectibles.name: Kitchenette sink
collectibles.method: Leave Office through its north exit and destroy the memoriam beside the sink.

collectibles.name: Medication Room bed
collectibles.method: Use Level 3 Wristband on the empty cell and destroy the memoriam behind its bed.

collectibles.name: Records Room closet
collectibles.method: Break the sounding closet with Leon’s hatchet and destroy the memoriam inside.

collectibles.name: Workshop bench
collectibles.method: Move Joint Plug to the Workshop door and destroy the memoriam on the workbench.

collectibles.name: Bunkroom television
collectibles.method: Power the Boiler Room corridor doors with a Joint Plug and destroy the memoriam on the television.

collectibles.name: Private Lab desk
collectibles.method: Destroy the memoriam on the second desk.

collectibles.name: Garden-light pedestal
collectibles.method: Before entering the wooden door at the top of the roof stairs, turn left and use the scoped rifle to shoot the memoriam below on a lit garden pedestal.

collectibles.name: Café Oasis counter
collectibles.method: At the first intersection, enter the first open building on the right route and destroy the memoriam behind the counter.

collectibles.name: Highway wreck
collectibles.method: After using the binoculars, face west toward the elevator and snipe the memoriam on a wrecked van ahead of a delivery truck.

collectibles.name: Parking Garage box
collectibles.method: After the first stealth tutorial enemy, enter the room on the left and destroy the memoriam on the box.

collectibles.name: Bus driver seat
collectibles.method: Beside File 52, shoot the memoriam positioned behind the bus steering wheel.

collectibles.name: Apartment refrigerator
collectibles.method: Open the balcony gate with the crank, climb its ladder, turn right, and destroy the Mr. Raccoon memoriam inside the open refrigerator at the floor’s rear.

collectibles.name: Gas Station shelf
collectibles.method: Shoot down the street ladder opposite Cedarbrook Apartments, enter the station, and destroy the memoriam on the metal shelf.

collectibles.name: Sewer pipe
collectibles.location: @loc{West end of East Raccoon City main road}
collectibles.method: Activate the crane shortcut toward Central Camp; while crossing, look down-left and shoot the memoriam in the open pipe.

collectibles.name: Train seat
collectibles.method: Power the crane-side generator, descend underground, and destroy the memoriam on a passenger seat in the required train car.

collectibles.name: Willis Tower shelf
collectibles.method: Power the Central Camp rooftop generator, zipline to Willis Tower, go upstairs, follow the sofas right, and destroy the memoriam on the shelf.

collectibles.name: Tanker rubble
collectibles.method: When Leon is back on foot, turn slightly left and destroy the memoriam in front of the ruined tanker.

collectibles.name: Operations Room rubble
collectibles.method: Break through the wooden barricade and destroy the memoriam in the rubble on the left.

collectibles.name: Library bookshelf
collectibles.method: Face the central tall bookcase from the north, inspect its bottom row, count one compartment from the left edge, and shoot the memoriam concealed behind books in the next compartment.

collectibles.name: Gun Shop Kendo window
collectibles.method: After the cutscene, enter the open side alley, look up at its far end, and shoot the memoriam in the window left of the Umbrella billboard.

collectibles.name: ARK corridor boxes
collectibles.location: @loc{ARK corridor outside the N0-AH save room}
collectibles.method: Leave the save room, walk straight, and destroy the memoriam behind the boxes on the right before descending.

collectibles.name: Operations Room monitor
collectibles.method: During the alarm, destroy the final memoriam in front of the large monitor.

achievements.description: Complete the main story by releasing Elpis within four hours.
achievements.summary: Finish the main story in under four hours and select “Release Elpis.”

guide.context: Pausing stops the timer. Casual difficulty and bonus items are allowed; a first completion unlocks the Challenges > Speed Demon timer and Koketsu provides an unbreakable Grace knife.

steps.text: After the first run, spend 5,000 CP on @item{Koketsu} under @mechanic{Bonuses > Special Content}, then start a fresh Casual game.

Use these pace checks: Attic Leon 0:45, Care Center Basement 0:53, Courtyard 1:10, Water Treatment 1:20, Raccoon City arrival 1:25, motorcycle finish 2:05, Orphanage finish 2:17, ARK arrival 2:27, ARK Grace 2:35, ending 3:00.
At the final choice, select @mechanic{Release Elpis} and complete the ending before the timer reaches 4:00:00.

achievements.description: Earn 200,000 credits.
achievements.summary: Collect 200,000 cumulative credits after taking East Raccoon City’s Tactical Tracker.

guide.context: Kills from the first playthrough count, but earned credits update only when Leon opens a Supply Box. The total persists across playthroughs.

steps.text: At @loc{East Raccoon City Central Camp}, take @item{Tactical Tracker} from the first Supply Box beside the save point.
Kill enemies throughout Leon’s routes and periodically open any @mechanic{Supply Box} to register the earned credits.
Continue across later playthroughs until the recorded total reaches 200,000.

achievements.description: Collect 5000 microsamples of infected blood with the blood collector.
achievements.summary: Collect 5,000 infected-blood microsamples cumulatively with Grace’s Blood Collector.

guide.context: Blood collection persists across manual-save reloads and playthroughs. Transfusion Bags add blood instantly once the collector has room.

steps.text: Obtain @item{Blood Collector} in the @loc{Care Center Blood Lab} and fill it through normal collection.
Spend the stored blood on crafting, gather several @item{Transfusion Bags}, and make a manual save.
Consume the bags, reload the save, and repeat until cumulative collection reaches 5,000 microsamples.

achievements.description: View all models.
achievements.summary: Buy all 44 Models for 4,400 CP, then open the viewer and display every model.

guide.context: All Models unlock after one story completion. Purchases alone do not satisfy the viewing requirement, and the Insanity reward supplies more than enough CP.

steps.text: After finishing the story once, open @mechanic{Bonuses > Models} and buy all 44 entries for 100 CP each.
Open the first model in the viewer and cycle through every purchased model until each has been displayed.

achievements.description: View all concept art.
achievements.summary: Buy all 56 Concept Art entries for 5,600 CP, then open the gallery and display every image.

guide.context: All Concept Art unlocks after one story completion. Save CP for bonus weapons until Insanity is complete; purchasing without viewing does not count.

steps.text: After finishing the story once, open @mechanic{Bonuses > Concept Art} and buy all 56 entries for 100 CP each.
Open the first image in the gallery and cycle through every purchased entry until each has been displayed.

achievements.description: Complete the main story without using herbs or med injectors.
achievements.summary: Complete a full story run without consuming any Herb or Med Injector.

guide.context: Picking up, storing, discarding, crafting with, or selling healing items is allowed. Steroids, armor, automatic story heals, and Casual regeneration do not count as healing-item use.

steps.text: Start a fresh @mechanic{Casual} game after Challenges become visible.

Never consume an @item{Herb} or @item{Med Injector}; verify @mechanic{Challenges > Never Touch the Stuff} remains at 0 after each major area and rotate manual saves because players have reported stale counter values.
Finish either ending while the counter remains 0.

achievements.description: Complete the main story without Grace using the blood collector.
achievements.summary: Complete the story without Grace using or collecting the Blood Collector.

guide.context: The challenge counter appears after one completion and must remain at 0 until the ending screen. Leaving Blood Collector on the Blood Lab table removes all ambiguity.

steps.text: Start a fresh Casual game after @mechanic{Challenges > Minimalist} becomes visible.
In the @loc{Care Center Blood Lab}, do not pick up @item{Blood Collector}; continue without blood-based crafting.
Finish either ending with the Minimalist counter still at 0.
